description: Header file defining byte swapping utilities for different data types, including functions to determine system endianness and perform byte swapping for various sizes.

classes.name: ByteSwapper
classes.description: Template struct providing byte swapping functionality for different data sizes.

methods.name: SwapBytes
methods.description: Function to swap bytes of a value or array of values, with optional forced swapping based on compile-time flags.

methods.name: IsLittleEndian
methods.description: Inline function to check if the system is little endian.

methods.name: IsBigEndian
methods.description: Inline function to check if the system is big endian.
